43.en: A monster attacked by this card will be destroyed at the End Phase of the fifth turn after the attack.

67.en: At the end of each of your opponent's turns, play 1 "Spirit Message" card from your hand or your Deck (then reshuffle your Deck). If "Spirit Message" cards "I", "N", "A" and "L" are all on the field in their proper order, you are declared the winner. If any of the cards are removed from the field while constructing the message, they are all sent to your Graveyard.

122.en: Activate by targeting 1 Set card in the Spell & Trap Card Zone; reveal it. If it is a Trap Card, force its activation. If the timing is incorrect, negate its effect and destroy it. After this effect resolves, shuffle this card into the Deck instead of sending it to the Graveyard.
122.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

170.en: Cannot be Special Summoned unless you Tribute 2 monsters, including "Grand Tiki Elder" or "Melchid the Four-Face Beast". When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, equip 1 "Mask of Remnants" from your Deck to a monster on the field, then shuffle your Deck.
170.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

173.en: When you inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points with this card, draw 1 card from your Deck.

174.en: Any DARK monster attacked by this card is automatically destroyed. Damage calculations apply.

263.en: When you activate this card, you cannot conduct your Battle Phase this turn. You can Tribute 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field as if it were your own monster.
263.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

273.en: If this card is attacked by an opponent's monster, you can treat another one of your monsters as the attack target and conduct damage calculation.
273.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

322.en: When this card battles a Warrior-Type monster, its ATK and DEF each increase by 2000 points during damage calculation.
322.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

333.en: FLIP: Take control of 1 Machine-Type monster your opponent controls until your next End Phase. A monster that destroys this card by battle loses 500 ATK and DEF.
333.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

357.en: You may Special Summon this card by offering "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" from your hand or the field as a Tribute. If "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" are in the Graveyard, you can offer this card as a Tribute to Special Summon these 3 cards to the field.

364.en: If this card is the only card in your hand, you can Normal Summon it in face-up Attack Position without Tributing.
364.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

378.en: When 1 monster you control is targeted by an opponent's Spell, Trap, or attack, you can change the target to another monster you control.
378.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

416.en: The equipped monster loses 500 ATK and DEF. Your opponent can only attack the equipped monster.
416.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

433.en: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all LIGHT monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all DARK monsters by 400 points.

439.en: When you activate this card, you cannot Normal Summon, Flip Summon, or Special Summon this turn. Special Summon 4 "Sheep Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. They cannot be used as Tributes for a Tribute Summon.
439.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

455.en: When this face-down Defense Position card is attacked by an opponent's monster, equip this card to the attacking monster (without damage calculation). During your opponent's next Standby Phase, destroy the equipped monster and this card, and inflict damage to your opponent equal to the equipped monster's ATK.
455.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

496.en: A monster attacked by this card will be destroyed at the End Phase of the fifth turn after the attack.

611.en: When your opponent activates a Spell Card that targets 1 monster, change the target to another appropriate monster.
611.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

628.en: When a monster is sent to the Graveyard by battle, you can return that monster to the field in the same battle position it was in. This is not a Summon.
628.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

654.en: While "Lord of D." is face-up on the field, you can Special Summon up to 2 Dragon-Type monsters from your hand to your side of the field.
654.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

655.en: FLIP: Destroys 1 Trap Card on the field. If this card's target is face-down, flip it face-up. If the card is a Trap Card, it is destroyed. If not, it is returned to its face-down position. The flipped card is not activated.

657.en: When this card is changed from Attack Position to Defense Position, select and destroy 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field.

675.en: When your opponent activates a Spell, Trap, or effect that would destroy Trap Card(s) on the field, you can destroy this card instead.
675.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

895.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

896.en: When this face-down Defense Position card is attacked by an opponent's monster, you can redirect the attack to 1 opponent's monster. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Special Summon "La Jinn the Mystical Genie of the Lamp".
896.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

1023.en: When a monster on your side of the field is sent to your Graveyard this turn, you can Special Summon 1 monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck.

1037.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)

1057.en: FLIP: Each player selects and discards 1 card from their hand. A monster that destroys this card by battle loses 500 ATK and DEF.

1058.en: As long as this card remains face-up on the field, increase the ATK of all FIRE monsters by 500 points and decrease the ATK of all WATER monsters by 400 points.

1066.en: Flip 1 face-down Defense Position monster face-up. If the monster's DEF is 2000 points or less, the monster is destroyed. If the DEF is more than 2000 points, return the monster to its face-down Defense Position.

1090.en: While this card is face-up on the field, Dragon-Type monsters cannot be targeted by Spell, Trap, or monster effects.
1090.source: Manual translation of JP text (official TCG wording)
